description: Search jobs.ac.uk by keyword, sector, region, discipline, job type, hours, contract, workplace, salary or posting date, or fetch specific jobs.ac.uk posting URLs, or enumerate every current vacancy from the site sitemap. The search filters are applied client-side over the complete current board (about 1,856 live jobs).

contractTypes.description: Client-side contract filter. Older saved tasks use `permanent`, `fixed-term-contract` and `temporary`.
contractTypes.title: Contract type

disciplines.description: Client-side discipline filter. Values are matched against the live board's discipline labels (e.g. `Computer Sciences`, `Cyber Security`, `Economics`); old saved-task slugs such as `computer-sciences` or `agriculture-food-and-veterinary` are also accepted. Leave empty for all disciplines.
disciplines.title: Disciplines

fetchFullDescription.description: Visit each posting's detail page for the full description, structured salary, dates, hours, contract, workplace, employer job reference and apply link. When off, search rows still carry the complete listing fields from the current board dataset. Always on for byUrls/allJobs.
fetchFullDescription.title: Fetch full job details

hoursTypes.description: Client-side working-hours filter. Older saved tasks use `full-time` / `part-time`.
hoursTypes.title: Hours

jobTypes.description: Client-side job-type filter. Older saved tasks use the values `phds` and `masters`.
jobTypes.title: Job types

jobUrls.description: Direct jobs.ac.uk posting URLs, e.g. `https://www.jobs.ac.uk/job/DTS722/lecturer-in-pharmacy-practice-maternity`. Also accepts `/job/DTS722/...` paths.
jobUrls.title: Job URLs (mode=byUrls)

keywords.description: Free-text terms matched by jobs.ac.uk against the job title, employer, department, disciplines and location (e.g. `lecturer`, `research fellow`, `PhD studentship`). Leave empty to browse all jobs that match the other filters.
keywords.title: Keywords

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. jobs.ac.uk currently publishes about 1,856 live vacancies.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: What to fetch: run a search, fetch specific posting URLs, or enumerate every live vacancy from jobs.ac.uk's sitemap.
mode.title: Mode

onlyNew.description: Suppress jobs already delivered by an earlier run using the same state store. Off by default; the daily test prefill never uses it.
onlyNew.title: Only new vacancies since last run

postedAfter.description: Client-side posting-date floor in `YYYY-MM-DD` form. Search mode filters on each job's `goLive` date; allJobs mode filters the sitemap `<lastmod>` (which equals `goLive`). Leave empty for no date filter.
postedAfter.title: Posted on or after

postedWithinDays.description: Client-side freshness filter: keep vacancies posted in the last N days (0 = off). When combined with `postedAfter`, the more restrictive date wins.
postedWithinDays.title: Posted within the last N days

region.description: jobs.ac.uk's own regional facet: 13 published regions plus `All locations`, which does not filter. `England` covers London and the four English sub-regions; `Asia` and `Middle East` both match the source label `Asia & the Middle East`; `South America` matches `South & Central America`.
region.title: Region

salaryBands.description: Legacy annual salary bands (GBP). Matched client-side against the advert's numeric salary range; adverts without a numeric salary are excluded when a band is selected. Use `salaryMin` / `salaryMax` for an exact range.
salaryBands.title: Salary bands (legacy)

salaryMax.description: Client-side annual salary ceiling: keeps adverts whose own maximum advertised salary is at most this value. Adverts without a numeric salary are excluded when set.
salaryMax.title: Maximum salary (GBP)

salaryMin.description: Client-side annual salary floor: keeps adverts whose own minimum advertised salary is at least this value. Adverts without a numeric salary are excluded when set.
salaryMin.title: Minimum salary (GBP)

sector.description: jobs.ac.uk's top-level vacancy sector. `All sectors` does not filter.
sector.title: Sector

sortOrder.description: Date placed returns the newest vacancies first; closing date returns the vacancies closing soonest first. `relevance` is a legacy value kept for saved tasks; it behaves as date placed.
sortOrder.title: Sort by

stateKeyValueStoreName.description: Named key-value store used to remember delivered job IDs when `onlyNew` is enabled. Use a different store name to keep separate alert histories.
stateKeyValueStoreName.title: Only-new state store

workplaceTypes.description: Client-side workplace filter. Older saved tasks use `on-site`, `hybrid` and `remote`.
workplaceTypes.title: Workplace

title: Jobs.ac.uk Academic Vacancy & Studentship Scraper Input
